description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role is instrumental in ensuring the highest standards of staff education and patient safety within our compassionate care environment. You will play a key part in fostering a culture of continuous learning and adherence to best practices.

This position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting your expertise and commitment. If you are a proactive and skilled Registered Nurse passionate about staff development and infection prevention, we encourage you to apply and contribute to our mission of exceptional patient care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development and education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
